data.narrative:
Alpine Eagle, a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Jan-Hendrik Boelens and Timo Breuer, has raised €10.25M to date. Valuation analysis relies on two applicable methodologies triangulated against a comp universe of 10 private and 2 public peers in Defense & Security, including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, and public comparables DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS.

Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x multiplier to the €10.25M raised as a proxy baseline, yielding €26M. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE at $1.0B (Seed), Singularity at $400M (Series A), and NODA AI at $125M (Series A). This peer set produces a median valuation of $400M with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B.

The two-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $22M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $213M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty: the stage-progression method yields significantly lower results given Alpine Eagle's early funding profile, while peer-median analysis is heavily influenced by UFORCE's $1B seed valuation as an outlier. Key uncertainties include Alpine Eagle's relative technical maturity versus peers, customer traction visibility, and defensibility of IP within a crowded frontier-defense landscape. Resolution of product-market fit evidence will be critical to narrowing this range at Series A.
